findings.title: Synchronous backend work reached through MCP blocks the whole ASGI loop.
findings.body:
services/working-memory-assistant/mcp_http.py:140
All 10 callbacks are now async around synchronous calls. A SQLite lock wait or the synchronous ADHD state hint in recap would stall other requests, including /health. Plan step 2 discloses the blocking. Carried from 006; severity unchanged.

findings.title: Resolved dependency versions are not pinned on a build cache miss.
findings.body:
services/working-memory-assistant/Dockerfile.dope-memory:39
pip install .[services] follows COPY of src and tools; apt-get upgrade is at line 23. Plan step 5 discloses this and asks to record deployed versions, but no helper records or enforces them. Cache state not observed. Carried; disclosure improved.

findings.title: start does not verify data mounts or anonymous volume identity after recreation.
findings.body:
proof/MACRO-DMX-CODEX-MCP-COMPOSE-20261128-007/W03/run_runtime.py:134
It checks running state, eventbus, auth mode and image only. The volume ID is asserted in backup modes (lines 100-101). The mount check is manual. Carried.

findings.title: Write probes, database attribution and disable-on-failure are not mechanically gated.
findings.body:
proof/MACRO-DMX-CODEX-MCP-COMPOSE-20261128-007/W03/run_client_check.py:18
The probe checks only the audit gate file, not the frozen subject or functional and enable receipts. Readback is a substring check (line 59). Attribution and disabling have no frozen helper. App-server stderr is written under the proof tree (mode 0600). The plan's 007 paragraph makes these manual steps. Carried.

findings.title: The one-shot build uses a 1200s timeout, shorter than the canonical default, with no replay path.
findings.body:
proof/MACRO-DMX-CODEX-MCP-COMPOSE-20261128-007/W03/run_runtime.py:158
docker_runtime.py:43 defaults DEFAULT_BUILD_TIMEOUT_SECS to 1800. On TimeoutExpired, private_log raises, build.json stays PREPARED_ONCE, a replay is refused and memory remains stopped. Plan step 9 discloses that a build failure may leave memory stopped. Also present in 006 but not recorded there. Static only; build duration unknown.
